Body.Content:
Azure Content Delivery Network provides secure, reliable content delivery with broad global reach and rich feature set. New, enhanced reporting capability will enable you to analyze several metrics including bandwidth consumption, data transferred, and cache hit ratio. This release will provide templates for integration with Operation Management Suite. Customers will also be able to access these metrics via REST APIs. In addition, customers will be able to save these analytics as logs to their storage accounts for further analysis. These new features will be available for both Azure Content Delivery Network​ from Verizon and Akamai.

​Learn more about these new features for Azure Content Delivery Network.
